assertions: A still-qualified exact model binding produces one validated REVIEWABLE draft through the dedicated Session.
Qualification or configuration drift sends no customer report data to the model and persists one redacted FAILED terminal.
The model receives only selected Finding and allowlisted Evidence identities and never receives database credentials or application capabilities.
A failed attempt can be followed only by a new Idempotency-Key, record, Run identity, and Session while the failed history remains unchanged.
Replaying either key never performs a second model attempt.
